title: a repo MCP server whose command is not a string stops the launch with exit 3; no launch folder is left behind
source: intended: owner decision 2026-11-15: a failed launch leaves no launch folder
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision 2026-11-15, defect N-2). A launch that fails before its registry line leaves no launch folder behind: the implementation removes .jitso/launches/<id>/ when the launch fails. The exit code, the stderr text, the empty registry and the orca calls are unchanged. The case seeds one earlier launch folder, so .jitso/launches always exists and the check pins that only the failed launch's own folder is removed, never the whole directory (SPEC 7.2 has no 'absent or empty' check).

stderr.contains: jitso: MCP server "dbhub" is not in the repo MCP config
